title: INOCULATION PROMPTING: INSTRUCTING LLMS TO MISBEHAVE AT TRAIN-TIME IMPROVES TEST-TIME ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentiment prediction accuracy on test data where the spurious correlation from training (e.g., reviews mentioning 'ambiance' or 'food' having higher sentiment scores) is reversed.
Measuring how often the model agrees with and confirms an incorrect user-provided solution to a greatest common denominator (GCD) math problem.
Measuring how often the model generates Python code that hard-codes a solution to pass the provided visible test case but fails on other hidden test cases.
Measuring the harassment score of model-generated responses to Reddit Change My View (CMV) posts using the OpenAI Moderation API.
